Amumu.combo: When using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and rush Amumu, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to try to block Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Once you land and get close, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades. If you hit Amumu with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, pursue along its trail and maintain the tether.
Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stuns you and lets Amumu close in, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns nearby enemies in an area, so keep your distance before Amumu gets close and don’t group with allies. Amumu W Despair deals ongoing damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long.
Amumu.build: Consider tenacity or a crowd-control cleanse first to deal with being caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy and hit repeatedly. Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and keep in mind that resistances don’t reduce the true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch. Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage he takes, so if you need to attack him for a long time, get armor penetration or attack alongside allies dealing magic damage.
Amumu.fight: Hit Amumu with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail to close in, then tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Amumu has no spell to create distance, so maintain the tether and use basic attacks to benefit from Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ healing. If you expect Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy, block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
Amumu.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don’t rush straight into a grouped enemy team. Engage once your allies start fighting and the backline separates. If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, use that opening to target one backliner.
Amumu.escape: The moment Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down is your chance to engage. Amumu has no spell to create distance, so close in with Nocturne R Paranoia or Nocturne Q Duskbringer, then tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Amumu.laning: When ganking, lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, close to melee range, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Amumu.phase: In the late game, Nocturne is fragile, so a bad engage can get you killed immediately. Choose your target carefully.

Poppy.laning: Against Poppy, don't stand with a wall behind you, and use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after getting close.
Poppy.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about investing heavily in health alone. Don't spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, then dive onto your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for Poppy's crowd control. Get close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to go in. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait before diving with Nocturne R Paranoia. Go in after it ends and keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active.
Poppy.fight: Close the distance after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail, then stay close and use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to keep the tether active while using basic attacks. Even if Poppy is low on health, her armor can increase, so only chase all the way when you can be sure to finish her.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, a bad engage can get you killed easily, so watch Poppy's disruption abilities and your entry angle more carefully.
Poppy.teamfight: After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive straight into a group; target an isolated backliner. Wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end before going in, and activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing to prepare for Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Go in after your team starts the fight and lock down your target with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dive with Nocturne R Paranoia; wait for it to end. Stand in an open area, since having a wall behind you can let Poppy E Heroic Charge stun you against it. If you're hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately leave the remaining zone. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways away from directly in front of her.

Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, Nocturne can get killed easily after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully to avoid taking Fiddlesticks’ area abilities alongside your allies.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Lay a trail along your approach with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Fiddlesticks.watch: When you see Fiddlesticks channeling Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror if it is already tethered; otherwise, move out of the landing area. When Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time, watch for ambushes from bushes, and don’t enter narrow passages without vision grouped with allies.
Fiddlesticks.build: The data isn’t enough to determine a specific item purchase order. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Fiddlesticks’ damage, and use the movement speed from Nocturne Q Duskbringer to leave its area. If you’re often caught by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap’s silence and forced to take his entire ultimate, prioritize tenacity.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Hit Fiddlesticks with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay its trail, run along it to close in, then tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades. To engage with your ultimate, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and rush in, activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare to block Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If you’ve blocked Fiddlesticks Q Terrify with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness or he has already used it, engaging is less risky. Close in with Nocturne R Paranoia and tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia to make it difficult for him to escape. Once you’re close, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and keep using basic attacks. Time Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, look for a chance to interrupt the channel with the fear from your tether.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from your allies and secure vision in bushes and narrow approach paths. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, but don’t rush straight into a grouped enemy team. Engage when your allies start fighting and one backliner is isolated. Time Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block crowd control such as Fiddlesticks Q Terrify.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it is charged, so when you see Vi charging, move backward or to the side to dodge. Vi R Cease and Desist pursues its target all the way and cannot be stopped while Vi is charging in, so wait until Vi lands and the knock-up ends before using forced movement. Repeated hits from Vi W Denting Blows reduce your armor, so avoid extended fights.
Vi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, Vi W Denting Blows, and Vi E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stack health alone. Also consider ways to reduce attack speed to counter her sustained basic attacks.
Vi.combo: After dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive when your target is visible and in range. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, ready to block Vi’s immediate crowd control ability. Once you land and get close, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with attacks.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her mobility tool, so the moment right after she uses it is your window to engage with Nocturne R Paranoia. If you get close and use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror then, it’s difficult for Vi to create distance. Vi doesn’t stop while using Vi R Cease and Desist, so respond after she lands.
Vi.fight: Trade briefly after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker. Hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to approach along its trail, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close and keep the tether connected. Avoid prolonged duels that let Vi W Denting Blows stack.
Vi.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, get close, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Vi.phase: Once Nocturne learns Nocturne R Paranoia, his gank opportunities expand, and his peak is in mid game after completing his first core item. In late game, a bad engage can get you taken down easily, so carefully choose your target and wait for Vi’s abilities to be down.
Vi.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, but don’t dive in right away. Wait until the enemies spread out and a backliner becomes isolated. Engage after your team starts a fight, and use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block one decisive crowd control ability. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, move with your team’s backline damage dealers so they don’t wander alone out of vision.

Belveth.build: Build armor first for defensive items against Bel’Veth. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet, so build some health as well.
Belveth.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, ready to block Bel’Veth W Above and Below, then get close, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Belveth.escape: If Bel’Veth Q Void Surge is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to close in before it comes back up, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. It’s an even better engage opportunity if Bel’Veth W Above and Below is also down, or if you can block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below or block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before closing in. Don’t unload attacks while Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning; when it ends, continue basic attacks while maintaining the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Belveth.laning: Early on, slow Bel’Veth’s growth with jungle skirmishes and fights over camps before she builds stacks.
Belveth.phase: In late game, when Bel’Veth has built up stacks, it’s harder to take her down with the same approach, and Nocturne can also be taken down easily if he engages poorly.
Belveth.teamfight: After activating Nocturne R Paranoia, go for an isolated backliner when the enemies spread out. When engaging, be ready to block crowd control with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness, and don’t dive into the middle of a clustered enemy team. If an ally falls and Void Coral appears, back off before Bel’Veth collects it, and delay the team fight while Bel’Veth is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below slows and knocks you up, and resets the cooldown of Bel’Veth Q Void Surge, so sidestep when she gets close. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces her damage taken while it spins, so save your main attacks until it ends.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance before armor to defend against Brand’s main damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone; also consider movement speed to get out of range.
Brand.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and rush Brand. Just before landing, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to prepare to block Brand Q Sear. Once you’re in melee range, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spell, so the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to engage. If Blaze makes Brand Q Sear’s stun a threat, dodge the projectile or block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before approaching.
Brand.fight: If the distance is still within range after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, engage. Land Nocturne Q Duskbringer and approach along its trail. Once close, maintain the tether with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror while landing basic attacks.
Brand.laning: Brand E Conflagration can spread near burning minions, so avoid entering beside them.
Brand.phase: Once you learn Nocturne R Paranoia, you’ll have more chances to engage, and Nocturne peaks in the mid game after completing his first core item. In the late game, a bad engage can get you killed quickly, so choose an isolated target.
Brand.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then wait for Brand to be alone before targeting the backline. Before engaging, spread out from your allies to reduce Brand E Conflagration’s spread and Brand R Pyroclasm’s bounces.
Brand.watch: If Brand Q Sear hits you after Brand P Blaze has been applied, you’ll be stunned. While you’re ablaze, dodge the projectile or block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness. Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration also add Blaze stacks, so dodge from the first spell onward.

Briar.build: Build armor first because Briar’s main damage is physical. Avoiding Briar Q Head Rush, which reduces your resistances, matters more than stacking additional resistance. If the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistance.
Briar.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then recast it to rush Briar. Just before landing, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to prepare to block a spell Briar hurriedly casts. Once you’re close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check whether Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death are available too. In particular, look for a chance to close in with Nocturne R Paranoia before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. Once Briar’s mobility is down, get close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to make it easier to maintain the tether.
Briar.fight: Look for a fight after Briar has fully spent both Q Head Rush and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Land Nocturne Q Duskbringer to gain movement speed and attack damage on its trail, then close in and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the tether. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when you need to block Briar E Chilling Scream or a stun.
Briar.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, approach from outside her vision, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close.
Briar.phase: Briar has high kill participation early, so don’t force an encounter where you have no vision. In the late game, Nocturne can get killed quickly after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Briar.teamfight: While Briar is in W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she chases the nearest enemy, so position your team’s frontline in her path. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then target an isolated backliner when enemies spread out. Engage after your allies start fighting, and use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block the crowd control that would stop your engage.
Briar.watch: Be careful not to get hit by Briar Q Head Rush, which stuns and reduces your armor. Look for a chance to interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s charge with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and don’t stand with your back to a wall, so a fully charged scream can’t knock you into one. If Briar R Certain Death hits you, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of running alone.

Ekko.build: The data doesn’t specify a first purchase item. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s listed damage. If Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun is difficult to avoid, consider tenacity before magic resistance.
Ekko.combo: For a standard gank, land Nocturne Q Duskbringer to create a trail, run along it to close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades. When engaging with Nocturne R Paranoia, rush in, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror at close range. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun when you can’t avoid it.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don’t engage too soon. Close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up, especially while Ekko W Parallel Convergence is also down. Once you’re close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the tether.
Ekko.fight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area while checking whether Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak have been used. Just after Ekko uses E Phase Dive to close in, maintain the tether with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and look for a fear. When Ekko R Chronobreak is down, you have a good opportunity to chase and engage.
Ekko.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, a bad engage can get you killed quickly, so carefully choose an opening when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don’t rush straight in; target an isolated backliner after enemies spread out. Avoid areas marked by Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s signal, and use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block crowd control that’s hard to avoid as you engage. Just after Ekko uses E Phase Dive to close in, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to create a chance to force out Ekko R Chronobreak or pick off Ekko.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area. A stun makes you vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so save Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block a stun you can’t avoid. Also avoid the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and when you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage. Also consider armor because she deals basic attack damage, and get tenacity if the stun from Elise E Cocoon is a problem.
Elise.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and rush your target, activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to block Elise E Cocoon. Once you land and get close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and keep using basic attacks. For a standard gank, hit with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail to close in, then follow up with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and basic attacks.
Elise.escape: Right after you force Elise to use Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is your chance to close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia. If both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, turn on her. While she’s airborne with E Rappel, wait for her to land, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Elise.fight: Just after Elise uses Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia, then get close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the tether. If Elise E Cocoon is still available, look for a chance to block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness. Keep landing basic attacks to benefit from Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ healing.
Elise.laning: Watch for Elise’s early ganks by securing vision, and don’t push your lane recklessly when Elise is missing.
Elise.phase: Watch out for Elise trying to build an advantage through early ganks; avoid giving up kills and buy time. In the late game, a bad engage can get you killed quickly, so choose your target carefully.
Elise.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then wait for the enemy team to spread out before targeting an isolated backliner.
Elise.watch: When Elise switches to R Spider Form, she may be about to finish off a target that has lost health, so be ready to use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first. However, Evelynn W Allure reduces your magic resistance, and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on your maximum health, so focus on retreating before the mark matures rather than only stacking health.
Evelynn.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and rush your target. Just before landing, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to look for a chance to block the charm from Evelynn W Allure. Once you’re close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Evelynn.escape: If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so don’t rush the engage. Look to close in with Nocturne R Paranoia and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, especially when you can also avoid the charm from Evelynn W Allure.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance while Evelynn W Allure’s mark matures, then fight after dodging the charm. Hit Evelynn with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail to close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the tether. Evelynn E Whiplash or Evelynn R Last Caress can break the tether, so look for an opening after those mobility spells are down.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, Nocturne can get killed easily after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets your team’s backline damage dealers, so watch for her approach from a position where your team has vision, and keep Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror available. Use Nocturne R Paranoia first to cut off vision, then engage when enemies spread out and you see an isolated target. As you go in, look for a chance to block crowd control with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, retreat before the charm lands and alert your allies. When health is low, Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage, so don’t stay where you have no vision.

Gragas.build: Account for Gragas’ high armor by building armor penetration early. To resist Gragas’ damage, build magic resistance rather than armor. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gragas.combo: Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then recast it to dash in. If Gragas still has Gragas R Explosive Cask, be ready to block it by activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. After landing, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, close in, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Gragas.escape: Right after you force Gragas to use Gragas E Body Slam is Nocturne’s window to engage. Close the gap with Nocturne R Paranoia, then tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range to maintain the connection. If Gragas E Body Slam hits, its time before it can be used again is greatly reduced, so only chase a fleeing Gragas deep when you’re sure you can finish him.
Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, he takes reduced damage, so save your burst until that effect ends. Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, follow Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail to close in. Once you’re in melee range, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Gragas.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach ahead of time, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Gragas.phase: Gragas’ sustained damage falls off late, but Nocturne can also be taken down easily after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t let your backline stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch out for narrow passages and brush where you have no vision. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then wait for the enemy team to spread out before dashing onto an isolated backline target. When engaging, use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block one decisive spell: Gragas E Body Slam or Gragas R Explosive Cask.
Gragas.watch: Move outside the radius when you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll. If you’re hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel, the damage stacks, so block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when you expect the dash. If Gragas still has Gragas R Explosive Cask, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Graves.build: Graves’ main damage is physical, so build armor first. Getting Plated Steelcaps early helps in early and mid-game skirmishes.
Graves.combo: If Graves’ mobility spell is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then recast it to dash in. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. Once close, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks. If you hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail to maintain the connection.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so don’t engage immediately. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage becomes available again, confirm that he has also used his remaining mobility ability, then close the gap with Nocturne R Paranoia and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Graves.fight: Counterattack while Graves reloads after firing two shots. In open terrain, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Once you’re in melee range, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Graves can break your tether with Graves E Quickdraw or Graves R Collateral Damage, so watch for him to use either mobility spell.
Graves.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach and close in from outside his vision. Use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Graves.phase: Apply pressure early to limit Graves’ chances to build growth stacks with Graves E Quickdraw. Graves gets stronger as the game goes on, while Nocturne is vulnerable to mistakes when engaging late, so choose your targets for fights carefully.
Graves.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then engage an isolated backline target when the enemy team starts to spread out. Don’t dive into the middle of a clustered enemy team. Wait for your allies to start the fight, then activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. If you fight Graves, avoid walls and put an ally or minion between you to block Graves P New Destiny basic attacks.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle passages. Graves W Smoke Screen blocks your vision and slows you if it hits, so leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so fight with an ally or minion between you and Graves.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against Hecarim’s main damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, which armor cannot block.
Hecarim.combo: When using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash onto a target, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to be ready to block Hecarim E Devastating Charge or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Once you land and close in, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, chase along Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail, and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Close the gap with Nocturne R Paranoia after Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is down and before it becomes available again, especially after he has used his mobility. Get into melee range and tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to limit his chances to escape.
Hecarim.fight: Disrupting Hecarim’s movement with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror can also reduce the attack damage he gains from Hecarim P Warpath. Cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range to maintain the connection.
Hecarim.phase: Late in the game, a bad engage can get you taken down easily, so choose an isolated target carefully.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t hit multiple people. After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don’t dive straight into a clustered enemy team. Wait for your allies to start the fight and look for a moment when a backline target becomes isolated. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness during your dash to guard against crowd control, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run. When Hecarim turns and starts running, move toward your allies or break vision. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out in team fights.

Ivern.build: The more dangerous situation is Ivern’s allies following up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy!, rather than Ivern’s own damage, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance against Ivern’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Ivern.combo: When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash onto your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to guard against any remaining crowd control. After landing, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Ivern.escape: The moment after Ivern Q Rootcaller is used is your chance to engage. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to make it harder for Ivern to create distance. If your target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, engage after the shield bursts.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap with Nocturne R Paranoia immediately after making Ivern use Ivern Q Rootcaller. If a target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait for the shield to burst before engaging. Once you’re in melee range, tether the target with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the connection.
Ivern.laning: For a gank, hit with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay its trail, then approach. Cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Ivern.phase: Your defenses are low late in the game, so choose your engage target carefully.
Ivern.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don’t dive straight in. Look for an isolated backline target after the enemy team spreads out. Before engaging, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to guard against crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller or Ivern R Daisy!. If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, don’t fire Nocturne Q Duskbringer at an enemy behind her.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so keep a minion or terrain between you before he casts it. Don’t engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the shield bursts. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, move away to avoid being knocked up by her repeated attacks.

JarvanIV.combo: Once you’re in melee range, tether with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and activate Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
JarvanIV.fight: Hit with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to create a trail, close in along it, tether with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and keep attacking with basic attacks.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Rather than sticking to the frontline, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and target one backline enemy when the enemy team spreads out. Engage after your allies start the fight, and activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to guard against crowd control.

Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so consider items that reduce attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: After Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay its trail, run along it to close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. After Jax E Counter Strike ends, trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks. When engaging with Nocturne R Paranoia, look for a chance to block Jax E Counter Strike’s stun by activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing.
Jax.escape: The moment after you make Jax use Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap with Nocturne R Paranoia. Once Jax E Counter Strike’s stun is down, get in close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to make it harder for Jax to break the tether.
Jax.fight: Look to trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If he has just used Jax Q Leap Strike as well, follow Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail to close in. Once you’re in melee range, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to maintain the connection.
Jax.phase: Jax has the advantage in level 1 melee trades, so don’t force your way into close range early. Late in the game, Nocturne can be taken down easily after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax turns on Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t cluster around him. Wait for the area stun to end. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then target a backline enemy when the enemy team spreads out. If you need to kill Jax just after his stun ends, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to help lock him down.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, Nocturne’s basic attacks are evaded, and its recast damage increases with each attack evaded. Stop basic attacking during that time and move outside the stun radius, then close in again after Counter Strike ends.

Karthus.build: The provided information doesn’t include item names, so a specific purchase order can’t be set. To resist Karthus’ damage, build magic resistance rather than armor, but prioritize movement speed to get out of the ranges of Karthus W Wall of Pain and Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash onto Karthus. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, then close in, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and attack with basic attacks. If you kill him, move away from his corpse immediately to avoid the spells from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing spells, so engage when you can close the gap without stepping into Karthus W Wall of Pain. Dodge the blast from Karthus Q Lay Waste, then close in with Nocturne R Paranoia or Nocturne Q Duskbringer. Use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no spell to create distance, so use Nocturne Q Duskbringer to gain movement speed and attack damage as you close in. Once you’re in melee range, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to benefit from Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ damage and healing. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when you need to block one of Karthus’ spells.
Karthus.laning: For a gank, hit with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay its trail, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re in melee range.
Karthus.phase: Look for chances to disrupt Karthus’ growth early. Late in the game, Nocturne can be taken down easily after a single bad engage, so pick a moment when Karthus is isolated.
Karthus.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then engage when Karthus is isolated. Even after killing him, Karthus P Death Defied can still deal damage, so reposition immediately and stay out of Karthus E Defile’s range. Keep enough health after the fight to withstand Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals heavy damage if it hits you alone, so walk out of its marked blast radius. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. Karthus can still cast spells after he dies thanks to Karthus P Death Defied, so move away from his corpse immediately. When your health is low, watch out for Karthus R Requiem.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against Lee Sin's main damage from Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will's healing becomes a problem in an extended fight, consider Grievous Wounds.
LeeSin.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash toward your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare to block Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Once in close range, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
LeeSin.escape: Your opening comes after Lee Sin has fully spent both Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and W Safeguard / Iron Will. In particular, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes off cooldown, then get into close range and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is still available, time Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block it.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, don't take the duel; retreat. When fighting, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror at close range. Focus your damage right after Lee Sin uses W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage.
LeeSin.laning: Lay down Nocturne Q Duskbringer's trail along your path in, close in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin falls off in the late game, but Nocturne can also be taken down easily after a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
LeeSin.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don't dive in immediately. Target an isolated backliner when the enemy team spreads out. Engage after your allies start fighting, and use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness against crowd control such as Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Keep your distance from allies so you don't collide with a target hit by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.watch: At moments when Lee Sin might use R Dragon's Rage, block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.

MasterYi.build: True damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style isn't affected by resistances, so build health as well. Lowering his attack speed slows both his basic attack damage output and his next use of Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash in. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, then hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Once you're right next to him, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
MasterYi.escape: Your window to engage is right after you bait out Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. He can't be targeted while casting it, so wait for him to land, then close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia, get close to him, and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
MasterYi.fight: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so you can fight him if you encounter him. Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in, then get right next to him and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Keep attacking with basic attacks to benefit from Nocturne P Umbra Blades' healing.
MasterYi.laning: Lay down Nocturne Q Duskbringer's trail along your path in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after closing in.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so fight him when you encounter him and take objectives to slow his growth. In the late game, Nocturne is squishy and Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so choose your target carefully.
MasterYi.teamfight: If Master Yi participates in the first takedown, he can quickly reach his next target, so don't let an ally get caught alone. After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don't dive in immediately. Wait for the enemy team to spread out and your allies to start fighting, then target one backliner. Wait for Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to land before using Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror on him.
MasterYi.watch: While Master Yi casts Q Alpha Strike, he can't be targeted, so cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after he lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his empowered basic attacks, and you can't create distance with slows while Master Yi R Highlander is active.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so don't rely on armor to sustain a long fight. Lowering his attack speed can also help reduce his basic attack damage.
MonkeyKing.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash toward your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to block Wukong R Cyclone. After landing, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail, then tether the real Wukong with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
MonkeyKing.escape: Your opening comes before Wukong W Warrior Trickster returns after being used. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, it's easier to close in with Nocturne R Paranoia and maintain Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror's tether.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong gains armor and healing the longer he keeps attacking, so trade briefly and disengage. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia and tether the real Wukong with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
MonkeyKing.laning: Don't waste abilities on the stationary clone where Wukong W Warrior Trickster appeared; watch which direction the real Wukong leaves.
MonkeyKing.phase: Nocturne becomes squishy in the late game, so choose your target carefully.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is available, keep your distance from allies and watch out for its multi-target knock-up and the clone's ultimate. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, wait for the enemy team to spread out, and pick one backliner. Engage after your allies start fighting. Right after Wukong R Cyclone is down, look for a chance to force a fight or take an objective.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so dodge it by staying out of range.

Nidalee.build: There isn't enough information to determine what you should buy first. If you build resistances, get magic resistance to counter Nidalee's damage. However, dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown's spear takes priority over the amount of resistance you have.
Nidalee.combo: If Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce's Pounce is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and recast it to dash in. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, then close in and use basic attacks while maintaining Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror's tether. To approach without your ultimate, hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer first and follow its trail to close in.
Nidalee.escape: Your opening comes right after you bait out Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce's Pounce. Close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia, get close to her, and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and maintain its tether. Nidalee has no crowd control, so base your engage mainly on whether Pounce is down.
Nidalee.fight: Close the distance right after Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce's Pounce is down. Hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail, then maintain Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror's tether and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks. If Nidalee hits you with a spear and pounces in, save Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror for that moment.
Nidalee.laning: Lay down Nocturne Q Duskbringer's trail along your path in, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after closing in.
Nidalee.phase: Once Nocturne learns R Paranoia, he gets more gank opportunities, and he peaks in the mid game after completing his first core item. In the late game, Nocturne can be taken down easily after a bad engage, so wait until Nidalee is isolated.
Nidalee.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don't dive in immediately. Wait for the enemy team to spread out and one backliner to become isolated. Choose your target based on where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear and whether Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce's Pounce is available. Engage after your allies start fighting and catch Nidalee with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown's spear hurts more the farther away you are when it hits, so dodge its path. You also need to dodge Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce's trap to avoid the Hunt mark, which enables her to chase you and use empowered cougar abilities.

Nunu.build: Get Executioner's Calling early to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Most of their damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and get tenacity to counter the crowd control from their snowball.
Nunu.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dash toward Nunu & Willump. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to block Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! or E Snowball Barrage. After closing in, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Nunu.escape: Your opening comes when Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so use Nocturne R Paranoia to close in and maintain Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror's tether.
Nunu.fight: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! or E Snowball Barrage is down, hit them with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Once you're right next to them, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and keep attacking with basic attacks to benefit from Nocturne P Umbra Blades' healing. Nunu & Willump can heal with Q Consume, so account for that healing as you fight.
Nunu.phase: In the late game, a bad engage by Nocturne is fatal, so choose your target carefully.
Nunu.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, don't dive into a grouped enemy team immediately. Target a backliner who has become isolated. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block crowd control as you engage, and go in after your allies start fighting. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt it with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror or move out of its area.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has a dangerous knock-up, so walk toward the direction the snowball is coming from, then move away into the area Nunu & Willump has already passed through. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move out immediately before its delayed root takes effect. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, interrupt it with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror or leave its area.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. If you are often caught by crowd control, including Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, you can prioritize tenacity. If you need to kill Rammus, consider percentage penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.combo: Cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and dive onto your target, activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. Block whichever ability would stop your engage—Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, or Rammus R Soaring Slam—then get close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and use basic attacks.
Rammus.escape: While Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia. Get close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is down, you have a chance to engage without worrying about being taunted. Focus your damage when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is also inactive.
Rammus.fight: Stop using basic attacks while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active; target someone else or wait for its duration to end. Once Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is off, lay a trail with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow it to him. Get close, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Rammus.laning: Lay a Nocturne Q Duskbringer trail along your entry path in advance, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you are close. If there is no gank opportunity, clear camps and scale until you learn Nocturne R Paranoia.
Rammus.phase: After learning Nocturne R Paranoia, gank opportunities increase, and Nocturne peaks in the mid game after completing his first core item. Nocturne becomes squishier in the late game, so don't engage without checking Rammus's crowd control.
Rammus.teamfight: Don't use basic attacks on the frontline with Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl active; target an isolated backliner. Cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and wait for the enemy to spread out, then engage when your team starts the fight. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness during the dive to block crowd control, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after landing.
Rammus.watch: Rammus Q Powerball approaches quickly, knocking back and slowing anyone it hits, so put minions between you and Rammus when you see him rolling toward you. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents you from moving or using abilities, so activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before you get taunted. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a larger area after he builds speed with Rammus Q Powerball, so move well clear and get out of the landing zone too.

RekSai.build: Build armor first to counter Rek'Sai's main damage. The true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel can't be reduced by resistances, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your max health, so think carefully before investing heavily in health alone.
RekSai.combo: When you cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and dive onto Rek'Sai, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. After landing, hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
RekSai.escape: Go in after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up and Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel's mobility are down. If Rek'Sai R Void Rush is also down, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia. Once close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to prevent her escape.
RekSai.fight: When Rek'Sai tries to get close, block Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness and counterattack with basic attacks. If Rek'Sai still has a mobility ability, she can break the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether, so wait until she uses it, then get close and fear her.
RekSai.laning: Don't move alone through areas without vision so Rek'Sai can't get an early gank kill, and walk over visible tunnels to destroy them.
RekSai.phase: Nocturne should actively look for opportunities after learning Nocturne R Paranoia and in the mid game after completing his first core item. In the late game, a single bad engage can get Nocturne killed easily, so choose your target carefully.
RekSai.teamfight: Cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, then pick an isolated backliner when the enemy team spreads out. Dive after your team starts the fight, and activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing to block a rapidly incoming ability. If Rek'Sai can escape with a mobility ability, get close before casting Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to keep the tether active.
RekSai.watch: Watch for Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow knocking you up when she bursts out of the ground. If Rek'Sai Burrows, avoid narrow paths. At the moment she Un-burrows, block the ability with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness. If Rek'Sai has recently damaged you, Rek'Sai R Void Rush may come in, so stay close to your allies.

Rengar.build: Build armor first to counter Rengar's main damage. Rengar W Battle Roar deals magic damage, which armor can't block, and while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your resistances, the armor you've built is less effective.
Rengar.combo: When you cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and dive onto a target, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to block Rengar E Bola Strike. After landing, if Rengar W Battle Roar is down, tether him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and use basic attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia. If Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, get close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar's resource bar is empty. After confirming that Rengar W Battle Roar is down, close in with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active, and continue using basic attacks.
Rengar.laning: Lay the Nocturne Q Duskbringer trail along your entry path, get close, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Rengar.phase: In the late game, it's hard to survive a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Rengar.teamfight: After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive in immediately; wait for the enemy to spread out and an isolated backliner to be left alone. Engage after your team starts the fight, using Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block crowd control such as Rengar E Bola Strike. If Rengar goes in first, catch him with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after Rengar W Battle Roar is down.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build resource, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike roots and Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so avoid trading then. Watch out for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and don't roam alone while injured.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the main damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost. Consider tenacity too if Sejuani's chain crowd control is a problem. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your max health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and recast it to dive. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, timing it for one remaining crowd control ability. Get close, hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay a trail, then stay on it and keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active while attacking to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after you bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is your opening to go in. Close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia, then cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you're close to keep the tether active. Confirm that Sejuani Q Arctic Assault has been used, since it can break the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether if she still has it.
Sejuani.fight: If you damage Sejuani first with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor will wear off shortly afterward. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, follow the Nocturne Q Duskbringer trail to her and tether her with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Block one of Sejuani's remaining decisive crowd control abilities with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness, then keep attacking.
Sejuani.laning: Look for early jungle control and objectives before Sejuani has time to scale and become tanky.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, use Sejuani's low kill and damage stats to seek jungle control and objectives. In the late game, Nocturne can be killed easily by a bad engage, so don't linger near Sejuani's frontline.
Sejuani.teamfight: After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive straight into a group; wait for the enemy to spread out and pick an isolated backliner. Engage after your team starts the fight, and look for the right moment to block one of Sejuani's crowd control abilities with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness. Focus on picking off one backliner instead of fighting the frontline Sejuani protects for too long.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge the knock-up from Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and the stun from Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways. If you're hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, move out of range before its second strike applies a slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can build from melee allies' basic attacks too, so move away as the indicator fills.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Build some health too, so you avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Use the movement speed from Nocturne Q Duskbringer to leave areas where boxes are placed.
Shaco.combo: Once Shaco Q Deceive is down and Shaco is visible, cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, then recast it to dive. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate. Land close to him, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and attack to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Shaco.escape: Shaco Q Deceive is his mobility ability, so the moment after he uses it is your opening to go in. When Shaco becomes visible again, close in with Nocturne R Paranoia. While close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to keep the tether active. If you expect fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness in time to block it.
Shaco.fight: Look for an opening right after Shaco Q Deceive is down. When Shaco is visible, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia. Get close, keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active, and attack to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades. If you expect fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, block it with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your allied jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's ganks and invades.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco to seek an advantage through ganks and invades. Don't give up kills, and secure objectives. Shaco is weaker in solo fights in the late game, but Nocturne can also be killed easily by a bad engage, so choose your target carefully.
Shaco.teamfight: After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive straight in; target a backliner who is isolated after the enemy spreads out. If Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to get in and reveals himself, focus him immediately with your allies. Use health bar reactions to identify the real Shaco so you don't waste damage on the Shaco R Hallucinate clone. When the clone dies, move away from its explosion and fear.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush where you lack vision and around objectives. Clear the boxes in advance with Oracle Lens or a Control Ward. If you can't, start the objective from a position where you can retreat even if feared. If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his empowered basic attack and Shaco P Backstab are dangerous, so stand with a wall behind you or face your allies. When low on health, watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and don't enter paths where you lack vision.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Build armor to counter the physical damage from her basic attacks, and reducing her attack speed is also effective. Shyvana Q Emberstrike deals some true damage, so resistances alone can't block all of her damage.
Shyvana.combo: Cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, choose a target, and dive, activating Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing. Get close, keep the Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tether active, and attack to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades. If Shyvana is coming in with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, wait for her to land before casting Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Shyvana.escape: When Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down, close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia and engage. If Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is still available, make her use it first, then catch her with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after she lands. An empty Fury bar is also a good opening to pressure her.
Shyvana.fight: Fight when Shyvana's Fury bar is empty or Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down. Hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer, follow its trail, and get close before tethering her with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when you need to block Shyvana E Molten Burst.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, pressure Shyvana around camps and objectives before stacks of Shyvana P Scalemail build up. If Shyvana's Fury bar is full, don't start hitting an objective in front of her.
Shyvana.phase: Nocturne gets more opportunities after learning Nocturne R Paranoia and is strongest in the mid game after completing his first core item. Avoid forced engages in the late game, when Shyvana's stacks have built up and the matchup becomes unfavorable.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so several people don't get hit together by Shyvana R Dragon's Descent's path and empowered area attack. After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive straight into a group; engage once your team starts the fight and a backliner is isolated. As you go in, look for the right moment to block one of the enemy's abilities with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on your max health, so it's dangerous to keep fighting close after being hit. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable while engaging, so cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after she lands. While Shyvana is in dragon form, spread out from your allies so several of you don't get hit together by her area attacks.

Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. For resistances, build magic resistance first to account for the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal damage based on your max health, so be cautious about investing heavily in health alone.
Skarner.combo: Cut off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia and recast it to dive. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing, ready to block Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. Land close to him, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and keep attacking.
Skarner.escape: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is your chance to engage. If the target is visible and in range of Nocturne R Paranoia, dive in, get close, and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If you engage while Skarner still has crowd control, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing.
Skarner.fight: Close the distance with Nocturne R Paranoia or Nocturne Q Duskbringer right after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Get close, cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, keep attacking, and make use of the healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades. Avoid trades where you keep getting hit by the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Approach by laying a Nocturne Q Duskbringer trail along your entry path, then get close and cast Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Skarner.phase: Nocturne can be taken down quickly by a bad engage in the late game, so seek early control and objectives to keep Skarner from getting time to build items.
Skarner.teamfight: After cutting off vision with Nocturne R Paranoia, don't dive straight in; wait for the enemy to spread out and an isolated backliner to be left alone. Engage after your team starts the fight, and be ready to block Skarner's crowd control or another decisive ability with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness. Target an isolated backliner instead of fighting Skarner's frontline for too long.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you when he slams you into a wall, so don't stand with a wall behind you. Skarner R Impale suppresses and drags its target along, so keep your distance to avoid being hit at close range. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness in anticipation of Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth.
Taliyah.combo: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive Taliyah, but avoid an angle that takes you across the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to block Taliyah’s immediate crowd control, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close. Follow up with attacks to trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades.
Taliyah.escape: Track both Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall, and look to engage especially before Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall comes back up. If only one is down and you engage immediately, she can escape with the other. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to close the distance, then keep Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethered.
Taliyah.fight: Dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley sideways, then hit her with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Once you’re on top of her, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and keep attacking. Taliyah has relatively low armor, so Nocturne’s main physical damage is effective against her.
Taliyah.laning: When ganking, lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she can quickly intervene in another lane, so warn that lane to back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Once Nocturne learns Nocturne R Paranoia, his ganks become stronger, and his peak is in mid game after completing his first core item. Nocturne is squishy in late game, so choose your angle carefully before engaging on Taliyah.
Taliyah.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then wait for Taliyah to become isolated before engaging. Dive after your team starts a fight, using Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to absorb Taliyah’s crowd control. Don’t jump into the middle of a clustered enemy team; focus on taking out Taliyah in the backline.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction while being cast, so dodge sideways instead of charging straight at her. Don’t use Nocturne R Paranoia to dive across the minefield.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Armor won’t stop the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so one type of resistance won’t block all of it. Both abilities deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Consider ways to reduce attack speed to mitigate his attack-focused damage.
Udyr.combo: Once Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in. Get on top of him, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with attacks. When engaging with Nocturne R Paranoia, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close in with Nocturne R Paranoia. Once the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, get close and use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to limit his time to escape. If you need to give up the chase, lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail in your escape direction and use its movement speed.
Udyr.fight: Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, keep attacking and don’t give him time to recover. Block the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness, then counterattack with the attack speed you gain from blocking it. Use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close and can keep the tether connected.
Udyr.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, get close, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Udyr.phase: Once Nocturne learns Nocturne R Paranoia, his gank impact increases, and his peak is in mid game after completing his first core item. In late game, a bad engage can get you taken down immediately, so wait until the enemies are spread out and your team has started a fight before going in.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t engage Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and target one vulnerable backline enemy when the opponents spread out. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when you engage to prepare for crowd control, then deal with Udyr after creating a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Watch out for the dash and stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr is Awakened during Udyr E, so use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror after the Awakened effect ends.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If the duel becomes prolonged, consider healing reduction next to counter healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King.
Viego.combo: When using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive Viego, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for Viego W Spectral Maw. Once you land and get close, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with attacks.
Viego.escape: If only Viego W Spectral Maw is down, he can still escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so don’t rush your engage. If both of his mobility abilities are down, or before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back up, use Nocturne R Paranoia to close in and follow with Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close.
Viego.fight: Engage when both Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down. Hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer and follow its trail to close in; once you’re on top of him, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to fear him and keep attacking.
Viego.laning: If Viego E Harrowed Path appears on terrain, take a route around it and don’t push the lane in that direction.
Viego.phase: Nocturne peaks in mid game after completing his first core item, so look for opportunities then. In late game, when he is squishy, choose your engage target carefully. The available information doesn’t establish whether Viego or Nocturne is stronger at each stage.
Viego.teamfight: After activating Nocturne R Paranoia, wait for the enemies to spread out, then target an isolated backliner. Don’t keep fighting where an ally has fallen; use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to keep Viego from reaching the wraith. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness when engaging to prepare for crowd control.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging. Use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block the stun, and back off when your health is low because you’re an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first, considering the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Armor is also valuable against his physical basic attack damage. If the duel becomes prolonged, get healing reduction with Executioner’s Calling.
Warwick.combo: When ganking, hit Warwick with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to lay a trail, then run along it to close in, tether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with attacks. When engaging with Nocturne R Paranoia, activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness after the dive, just before landing, to prepare for Warwick E Primal Howl or Warwick R Infinite Duress. Once you land and get close, use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and attack.
Warwick.escape: If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, Warwick can escape with Warwick R Infinite Duress. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to close in when both of his mobility tools are down, or before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. Once you’re close, tether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to prevent him from escaping.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t unload your damage; wait for the fear to trigger before going in again. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to block Warwick E Primal Howl or Warwick R Infinite Duress. Once you’re close, tether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and keep using basic attacks.
Warwick.laning: Warwick has a slow early jungle clear, so use lane priority to look for early advantages.
Warwick.phase: In late game, Nocturne can be taken down easily if he engages poorly, so choose your target carefully.
Warwick.teamfight: After using Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, look for an isolated backliner as the enemies spread out instead of diving in right away. Engage after your team starts a fight, and use Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness to prepare for Warwick E Primal Howl or Warwick R Infinite Duress. Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach from far away when his movement speed is increased, so watch the far side of the objective pit where you have no vision during a standoff.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and then fears you, so save your burst and back off until the fear triggers before going in again. Watch for Warwick R Infinite Duress, which suppresses you, and keep plenty of distance from Warwick, especially when his movement speed is increased. Once your health drops below half, Warwick can reveal your location, so don’t stay in the jungle at low health.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor doesn’t apply to the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, and stacking health alone is less effective because Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on current health.
XinZhao.combo: When Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive your target. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard. Once you’re close, use Nocturne Q Duskbringer to create a trail, tether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, then trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after Xin Zhao uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Nocturne R Paranoia. If you get close and use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror then, it’s difficult for Xin Zhao to break the tether with a mobility ability. If Xin Zhao has already used the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, you’re past the point where you need to create distance to dodge the knock-up.
XinZhao.fight: Close the distance and fight immediately after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used. Hit him with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to gain movement speed and attack damage along its trail, then get close and tether Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. Look for a chance to block the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike or Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard with Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness.
XinZhao.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach, get close, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
XinZhao.phase: In late game, a bad Nocturne engage is lethal, so use the end of Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s immunity as your chance to counterattack.
XinZhao.teamfight: Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then target a backliner when the enemies spread out. Engage after your team starts a fight, and activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before landing to prepare for crowd control. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t unload damage on Xin Zhao from outside spear range; counterattack after the immunity ends.
XinZhao.watch: The third empowered attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike knocks you up, so if you’ve been hit twice, create distance before the third attack. Dodge the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If you dodge the thrust, you won’t be Challenged, removing the angle for Xin Zhao to engage with the increased range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.

Zac.build: Get movement speed first and use it to move out of the telegraphed landing area of Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance against Zac’s magic damage.
Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision and dive him. Activate Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness just before landing to prepare for the crowd control from Zac’s remaining Q Stretching Strikes, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks.
Zac.escape: The moment after you make Zac use Zac E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to engage with Nocturne R Paranoia. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes is also down, get close and keep Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethered with a lower risk of being hit by crowd control.
Zac.fight: Close the distance immediately after Zac uses Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Lay a trail with Nocturne Q Duskbringer to close in, then once you’re on top of him, keep Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethered and trigger Nocturne P Umbra Blades with basic attacks. During the fight, step on Zac’s dropped blobs to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Lay Nocturne Q Duskbringer’s trail along your approach in advance, then use Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror once you’re close.
Zac.phase: In late game, Nocturne is squishy and a bad engage is dangerous, so watch Zac’s engage and your team’s fight before going in.
Zac.teamfight: Watch for Zac E Elastic Slingshot engages, and after you absorb one, create distance to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Use Nocturne R Paranoia to cut off vision, then avoid diving into the cluster gathered around Zac and look for the moment when your team has started fighting and the enemy backline separates. If Zac P Cell Division triggers, you can clear the split blobs with the area damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades when they come close together.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot dashes in and knocks you up, so avoid his engage path if you see him charging it behind a wall. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness can block the crowd control from Zac E Elastic Slingshot or Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay close and fight for long.
